rows.item: No official market price exists anywhere in the repository
rows.detail: 78 markets stored with market price null and reason NO_OFFICIAL_SOURCE. ROI, CLV and the staking column cannot be computed until this is fixed.

rows.item: Open and close are the same capture for every market so far
rows.detail: A single capture per market means no genuine movement; re-capture is needed to produce a real open/close pair.

rows.item: The model is uncalibrated against any market
rows.detail: Walk-forward MAE 9.263 pts and Brier 0.217 show it is sane, but with no price attached nothing shows whether it beats a book.

rows.item: Moneyline inherits every error of the side model
rows.detail: Deriving the ML from the spread guarantees consistency but also guarantees correlated errors; books fit them jointly.

rows.item: Depth charts are club-published, mostly undated and often self-labelled unofficial
rows.detail: 14 of 32 captured charts say unofficial; 1 of 32 print an as-of date. Any depth-derived number carries this caveat.

rows.item: 22 week-10 absences cannot be joined to a depth chart at all
rows.detail: Mostly players the club does not list (practice squad, recent signings) or a chart that had not been updated. A blank here is a capture gap, not a zero.

rows.item: Two defensible readings of 'depth string' disagree on 7 players
rows.detail: Printed order across every column and depth inside the player's own column give different answers where a club prints multiple columns at one position. Both are published rather than one being chosen silently.

rows.item: No strategy reaches the 200-bet skill gate; the largest sample is n=88
rows.detail: One partial season cannot support a skill claim at any plausible bet rate.

rows.item: The only parlay-relevant correlation has n=8
rows.detail: The CIN team-mate coefficient is published with its interval, which spans nearly the whole range. No combo price can rest on it.

rows.item: Props cover 5 players, not a board
rows.detail: Five players were captured to prove the method; it is not a representative prop board.
No prize, payout or rule set is configured and none is promised; this desk makes no legal claim.

rows.item: Demotion gates D-2 to D-6 are defined but never exercised
rows.detail: They need a live strategy and a market price to test; only D-1 has a mechanical dry run.

rows.item: Rounding is applied at publication, not before the arithmetic
rows.detail: Fair lines are printed to 0.5 and probabilities to 3dp; downstream comparisons use the printed value, which can differ from the unrounded input in the last digit.

rows.item: Games with fewer than 3 prior club games would be refused, and none are on this slate
rows.detail: The rule is published and enforced in code; it has not yet had to fire, so it is untested against real data.
